charter.objective: Create learned and parameterized numerical research mechanisms for sequence-grounded Baseplane experiments.
charter.motivation: User clarification: Cellerator owns experimental ML-like math as well as qualified numerical execution.
boundaries: Cellerator local authority only. Baseplane owns sequence meaning; use explicit provider receipts.
Preserve CE-ML2-RUN-V1 and all unrelated work. No blanket task-prefix retirement.
Experiments are welcome immediately; public promotion is separate. No new general runtime prerequisite.
Inspect exact claims/leases before use; broad read coverage is not an authorization receipt.
acceptance_conditions: Concrete operators with truthful authored/compiled/run/compared status.
Declared numerical contracts and source-independent inputs; sequence interpretation remains Baseplane-owned.
charter.delegated_judgment: Use dependency-driven parallel family lanes after foundation integration. Dispatch bounded configured Codex subagents under the root claim and file ownership; the root retains lifecycle and acceptance. Lane count is potential independence, not agent capacity: obey the total active agent budget including root and any heads. Shared seams have one owner; integrate family patches before compositions and closure.
